title: Concept: Lockfile resolves a source archive instead of a package
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile entry that points at a forge source archive, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The archive is generated on demand from a branch or tag, so the installed bytes are not the published artifact and carry no registry integrity value.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: The archive is generated on demand from a branch or tag, so the installed bytes are not the published artifact and carry no registry integrity value.
